data.narrative:
Overview Energy is a seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Marc Berte and Andrew Cantino that has raised $20M to date. The valuation universe comprises 6 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, though no sufficiently narrow peer cohort exists at the same stage and valuation tier to support direct median benchmarking.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using $20M in total raised as a proxy for post-seed value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $50M. Public Space & Aerospace comparables trade at a median 23.9x revenue multiple across the five tickers, but this cannot be applied without Overview Energy's revenue, which remains undisclosed as is standard for private companies at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $42M to $57M, centered at $50M. The primary limitation is methodological breadth: only one triangulation method yielded a result, reflecting the scarcity of directly comparable seed-stage datapoints in frontier aerospace. Key uncertainties include the actual post-seed step-up multiple applicable to this subsector, Overview Energy's path to revenue, and whether the $20M raised figure fully captures all capitalization. This range should be updated as additional revenue or financing data becomes available.
